questions.stem: The setup: Lucia Gupta has taxable income of $10,100 and faces a flat 20% tax rate. How much income tax is owed?

options.misconception: reports income rather than the tax on it
adds the tax to income instead of computing it
doubles the tax rate

questions.learningObjective: Apply retirement accounts concepts to realistic financial decisions
questions.stem: The decision: Beatriz Khan wants $5,000 in 2 years. At an annual return of 10%, how much must be invested today to reach that goal?

questions.subject: PERSONAL_FINANCE
questions.learningObjective: Apply retirement accounts concepts to realistic financial decisions
questions.stem: Think it over: Marcus Hernandez is setting up a retirement account and asks why naming a beneficiary matters. What is the main reason?

options.text: It directs who receives the account and can avoid probate delays.
It guarantees the account will earn a higher return.
options.misconception: treats a designation as an investment feature

options.text: It lowers the amount of annual contribution that is allowed.
options.misconception: confuses a designation with a contribution limit

options.text: It removes the need to make any other estate plan.
options.misconception: overstates what a single designation accomplishes

questions.explanation: A beneficiary designation controls who inherits the account and generally passes outside probate, which speeds transfer and reduces confusion. It does not change returns or contribution limits, and it is only one part of a broader plan.
questions.hint: A designation decides who inherits and how quickly.
